edits.new: so they travel in the answer and in the decision record (GAP-2674; ASM-4396). The names `encumbrance_status`, `decision_record` and `encumbrance_unresolved` used by the rules are a value of the ACE read, a library object of RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and a reason code of R-DIL-06; none is a field or entity in LDM v9 or Data Classification v5, and none adds a column. The ACE views are read under DP-05 as the source of the read, and no LDM field name for them is given in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S2-E3013-APP-7).

edits.old: BR8 is the reason the read is a SELECT against the views and no ACE object is written.
edits.new:
BR8 is the reason the read is a SELECT against the views and no ACE object is written.

**Reference data.** The hold limit and the three clocks are parameters read from the rule set of the DEEDINLIEU and SETTLEMENT packages under the reference-data contract (DP-06, DP-07), with their package version. Their parameter keys are not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S2-E3013-APP-20).

**External calls.** The asset take-on is requested from rwb-asset (S5) through its contract, and the CCMS collateral release and the Land Office title check through the rwb-integration contract. The reference each returns is recorded in the decision record (GAP-1705).

**Working read of the check answer (GAP-2674, GAP-2675).** The readiness answer is an optional section of the treatment read of RWB-S2-E3001-CON. The encumbrance and title statuses are values of the ACE read, never a column of `rwb_treatment` and never derived in code. The three view ranges are read only. The title-set task is raised by the parent CaseWorkflow on the reported request, with the 5 working-day clock of R-SET-22, and the case states are moved by the parent. The decision code is the rule ID and version returned by the evaluated package. The contract v1 publishes the readiness section with checkType, encumbranceStatus, registrationStatus, titleSetStatus, checkedAt, ruleId, ruleVersion, holdUntil, collateralNo and assetKey as an optional addition to GET /treatments/{treatmentId} at the same major version; TitleSetTaskRequest as an element of the stage outcome with R-SET-22, its version, the 5 working-day clock and its reason code, which is not specified in the source documents (GAP-2675); and the errors 401, 403 with MSG-P4-002, 404, 422 with MSG-GEN-001 and 503.

**Boundary and timers (GAP-0736).** This service owns the encumbrance and title check. The parent CaseWorkflow in rwb-case owns the case state, the title-set task, its due date and the decision record. The case-side columns check_ref, check_outcome_code and decision_record_id are added by the P3 migration and not by this story; their field IDs are not specified in the source documents (GAP-0736). The timer is taken from the check answer, and until a parameter is named the platform one-hop default of 2 s applies. The requirement ID of this slice is not specified in the source documents (GAP-0736).
